scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @orbisium/server" "npm run dev -w @orbisium/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbisium/client && npm run build -w @orbisium/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @orbisium/game && npm run typecheck -w @orbisium/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @orbisium/server && npm run typecheck -w @orbisium/client
